text:
incident-bot: PAGER: high GPU saturation detected in hotpath-usw2 (>=95% for 6m), spike in 429s from serving gateway. Severity: sev2. Link: https://console.internal/alerts/1765432199 :rotating_light:

alice.ong: taking on-call. can someone post the quick metrics? 429 rate, queue size, autoscale events?

ben_runtime: 429s spiked to ~18% for the last 5m. hotpath queue length climbed from ~120 -> 1100 reqs in last 12m. Autoscaler attempted 3 scale actions, 2 failed (scale limit hit), last one queued. See grafana panels: https://grafana.internal/d/serving/hotpath-usw2

carmen_sre: looks like autoscaler hit the per-tenant gpu cap. Also seeing throttles from the rate-tier service: many requests getting 429s with body: `{"error":"rate_limited","policy":"tier_high*"}`

alice.ong: where are the requests queuing? front-end or hotpath pool?

ben_runtime: front-end token bucket is backing up requests into hotpath queue. The tier routing merged into hotpath for this customer group due to affinity rules. Token bucket for that tier has burst_window=60s and refill=200r/s but our incoming burst >1k/s.

dinesh_cs: customers are reporting latency/failed responses - support ticket #8762. Which customers are impacted?

ben_runtime: primarily two enterprise tenants pinned to hotpath-usw2. Traffic signature: long completion tokens (chat context) causing longer hold on GPU.

carmen_sre: temporary mitigation: remove tier affinity so requests can land on standard pool (lower-cost) while we fix hotpath. That will reduce 429s but may increase token cost. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

alice.ong: do it. execute canary change then open full rollback if errors. ben, can you prepare the routing override? deploy-bot: please run the rollout once ben approves.

ben_runtime: preparing override. patch below to run via control-plane API:

```
PATCH /v1/routes/override
{
  "match": {"customer_ids": ["ent-42","ent-99"]},
  "route_to": "standard-usw2",
  "reason": "hotpath saturation mitigation 1765432199"
}
```

ben_runtime: pushing change to canary 10% now. monitoring 2m for error delta.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: routes.override canary=10% (id: roll-1765432205)

carmen_sre: also increasing token-bucket burst limit for tier_high to allow more short bursts while autoscaler catches up. Command: `rbacctl set-rate tier_high --burst 1500 --refill 400`. This is just a temporary bump.

alice.ong: hold on changing token bucket without coordinating with product - that could blow through quota. Ben, any chance autoscaler capacity will come up if we give it 5-10m?

ben_runtime: autoscaler logs show backoff due to per-az GPU soft-limit (we're at account cap). The orchestrator tried to provision nodes but cloud quota returned 403. I submitted a quota increase request but that's not immediate. We need to buy us some time via routing + token-bucket tune.

dinesh_cs: for customers: I'll post a status update saying degraded for specific tenants, mitigation in progress, no data loss, ETA 20-30m. Ticket #8762 updated.

carmen_sre: canary looks good for 3m, 429 delta down from 18% -> 6% for canary traffic. Rolling to 50% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout in progress: routes.override canary=50% (id: roll-1765432240)

alice.ong: ok, increase tier burst but cap total sustained rate to avoid quota burnout. Suggest: `burst 1500`, `refill 400`, `window 10s` (short window). Carmen, do that and watch billing counters.

carmen_sre: applied: `tier_high: burst=1500 refill=400 window=10s`. Watching. Also disabled strict affinity for ent-42/99 so they can load balance across standard pool.

ben_runtime: hotpath queue draining slowly, queue length falling 1100 -> 420 in 8m. 429s overall dropped to ~3.2%. Autoscaler still pending cloud quota but we've reduced pressure.

dinesh_cs: posted customer update: "We've mitigated the production impact by temporarily routing traffic and tuning rate limits. Engineers are monitoring — ETA 20m." customers acknowledged.

alice.ong: good. can we create a short incident runbook entry: root cause = per-account GPU cap + aggressive tier affinity causing hotpath concentration; contributing = token-bucket tuned too low for real bursts. Mitigation = routing override + temporary burst increase + request for cloud quota. Action items:
- ben_runtime: follow up with cloud team re: quota (ticket #Q-8891)
- carmen_sre: revert burst/refill to conservative defaults once quota resolved, add autoscale fallback policy to prefer permissive routing earlier
- dinesh_cs: schedule customer postmortem update after 24h

ben_runtime: filed cloud quota ticket Q-8891 and noted urgency. Also adding an autoscaler change to prefer adding nodes in different AZ if possible to avoid single-az cap.

carmen_sre: will schedule a ratepolicy review. Also capturing the mitigation steps in incidents playbook.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: routes.override -> 100% (id: roll-1765432240).

alice.ong: last check: 429s at 1.1%, queue length ~90, GPUs at 74% utilization. Leaving on-call but marking this as managed. Will do post-incident follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to monitoring (sev3). Timeline saved to https://incidents.internal/1765432199.

ben_runtime: TL;DR: saturation from AZ-level cloud cap + aggressive tier affinity concentrated long-running requests; immediate fix was to broaden routing and temporarily increase burst window; long-term: quota increases + autoscaler fallback + ratepolicy tuning.

alice.ong: nice work everyone. I'll write the postmortem draft and link logs. good handoff to next on-call. :white_check_mark:
